```{r setup}
source("Rscripts/utils.R")
# Column definitions: see Tables/union-peaks-README.md
```

# Load peaks
```{r load-data}
hap_sel <- my_read_bed(cmd = "bgzip -dc -@ 8 Tables/union-peaks-cons.bed.gz", sort = FALSE) %>%
    filter(
        haplotype_distinct == "Haplotype-selective",
        is_primary_sample == TRUE,
    ) %>%
    data.table()
```

# Extract haplotype-selective peaks in wide format
```{r hap-selective-wide}
cat("Haplotype-selective peak rows:", nrow(hap_sel), "\n")

# pivot seq into wide by haplotype, merge with shared columns
merge_cols <- c("ind_key", "consensus_peak_id")
h1 <- hap_sel[Haplotype == "1", c(merge_cols, "seq"), with = FALSE]
h2 <- hap_sel[Haplotype == "2", c(merge_cols, "seq"), with = FALSE]
setnames(h1, "seq", "seq_1")
setnames(h2, "seq", "seq_2")

# take one row per peak for the shared columns, then join seqs
hap_sel_wide <- hap_sel[, .SD[1], by = .(ind_key, consensus_peak_id)] %>%
    merge(h1, by = merge_cols, all.x = TRUE) %>%
    merge(h2, by = merge_cols, all.x = TRUE) %>%
    select(
        -coverage, -fire_coverage, -score, -fire_cov_OV_cov,
        -Haplotype, -seq,
        -asm, -asm_chr, -asm_start, -asm_end, -asm_peak_id,
        -sample_id_peak_id_TEMP_COL,
        -is_SD_cons, -is_SD_asm,
        -num_overlapping_orig_peaks, -orig_peaks_overlapping_consensus
    ) %>%
    data.table()

# compute per-haplotype accessibility
hap_sel_wide[, `:=`(
    acc_1 = fire_coverage_1 / coverage_1,
    acc_2 = fire_coverage_2 / coverage_2,
    diff = fire_coverage_1 / coverage_1 - fire_coverage_2 / coverage_2
)]

# add sharing count
sharing <- hap_sel_wide[, .(
    n_ind_hap_sel = uniqueN(Individual_ID)
), by = consensus_peak_id]
hap_sel_wide <- merge(hap_sel_wide, sharing, by = "consensus_peak_id")

cat("Unique hap-selective peaks:", nrow(hap_sel_wide), "\n")
glimpse(hap_sel_wide)
```

# Summary
```{r summary}
hap_sel_wide[, .(
    n = .N,
    median_acc_1 = median(acc_1, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_acc_2 = median(acc_2, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_diff = median(abs(diff), na.rm = TRUE),
    median_mismatches = as.double(median(local_mismatches, na.rm = TRUE)),
    frac_SD = mean(is_SD, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = .(Individual_ID, Platform)]
```

# H1 vs H2 accessibility scatter
```{r hap-sel-scatter}
hap_sel_wide[!is.na(acc_1) & !is.na(acc_2)] %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = acc_1, y = acc_2)) +
    geom_hex(bins = 30) +
    scale_fill_distiller("", palette = "Spectral", trans = "log10") +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_x_continuous("H1 accessibility", labels = percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous("H2 accessibility", labels = percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    coord_equal() +
    my_grid()
my_ggsave("Figures/hap-selective-peaks-scatter.pdf", width = 3, height = 3)
```

# Accessibility difference distribution
```{r hap-sel-diff}
hap_sel_wide %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = diff)) +
    stat_bin(geom = "step", binwidth = 0.02, position = "identity") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.25, 0.25), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
    scale_x_continuous("Accessibility difference (H1 - H2)", limits = c(-1, 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous("# of peaks") +
    my_grid()
my_ggsave("Figures/hap-selective-peaks-diff.pdf", width = 3, height = 2)
```

# Sequence mismatches vs accessibility difference
```{r hap-sel-mismatches}
hap_sel_wide[!is.na(local_mismatches)] %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = local_mismatches, y = abs(diff))) +
    geom_hex(bins = 30) +
    scale_fill_distiller("", palette = "Spectral", trans = "log10") +
    scale_x_continuous("# sequence mismatches between haplotypes") +
    scale_y_continuous("| Accessibility difference |", labels = percent) +
    my_grid()
my_ggsave("Figures/hap-selective-peaks-mismatches.pdf", width = 3, height = 2)
```

# Sharing: how many individuals are haplotype-selective at each peak
```{r hap-sel-sharing}
sharing %>%
    rename(n_individuals = n_ind_hap_sel) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = n_individuals)) +
    stat_bin(geom = "step", binwidth = 1, position = "identity") +
    scale_x_continuous("# individuals haplotype-selective at peak",
        breaks = scales::breaks_width(1)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous("# of consensus peaks",
        labels = comma,
        trans = "log10"
    ) +
    my_grid()
my_ggsave("Figures/hap-selective-peaks-sharing.pdf", width = 3, height = 2)

# accessibility diff by sharing level
sharing_diff <- hap_sel_wide %>%
    mutate(sharing_cat = fcase(
        n_ind_hap_sel == 1, "1",
        n_ind_hap_sel == 2, "2",
        n_ind_hap_sel == 3, "3",
        n_ind_hap_sel >= 4 & n_ind_hap_sel < 9, "4-8",
        default = "9+"
    )) %>%
    mutate(sharing_cat = factor(sharing_cat,
        levels = c("1", "2", "3", "4-8", "9+")
    ))

median_labels <- sharing_diff %>%
    group_by(sharing_cat) %>%
    summarise(
        median_diff = median(abs(diff), na.rm = TRUE),
        n = n()
    )

sharing_diff %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = sharing_cat, y = abs(diff))) +
    geom_violin(fill = "grey90", color = "black") +
    geom_text(
        data = median_labels,
        aes(y = median_diff, label = paste0(round(100 * median_diff, 1), "%")),
        vjust = 0, size = 2
    ) +
    geom_text(
        data = median_labels,
        aes(y = 0.2, label = paste0("n=", comma(n))),
        vjust = 1, size = 2
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous("| Accessibility difference |", labels = percent) +
    xlab("# individuals sharing peak") +
    my_grid()

my_ggsave(
    "Figures/hap-selective-peaks-diff-by-sharing.pdf",
    width = 3, height = 2
)
```


```{r}
glimpse(hap_sel_wide)
```


```{r}
set.seed(42)
table_to_use <- hap_sel_wide %>%
    filter(Individual_ID != "HG002") %>%
    filter(
        n_ind_hap_sel == 5,
        fire_coverage_1 + fire_coverage_2 > 15,
        !is.na(hg38_chr)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    sample_n(5)
glimpse(table_to_use)

fwrite(table_to_use,
    "Tables/example-hap-selective-peaks-sample.tsv",
    sep = "\t",
    row.name = FALSE,
    col.names = TRUE,
    quote = FALSE
)
```
